Electronic Speedometer Adjustment Module for Sportbike and Metric Crusiers.



The SIM-1A-M electric speed correction module adjusts for Sportbike and Metric Cruisers equipped with electric speedometers to correct the speedometer and odometer after a change in tire size, pulley size or transmission gearing. The SIM-1A-M splices between the stock Sportbike or Metric Cruiser transmission sensor and the original speedometer and is easily tucked away into the bike's wiring harness after adjustment is complete.

  • Cutting or splicing is required.
  • Two push button switches allow the original speedometer reading to be increased or decreased easily.
  • Ability to correct the speed to within 1 MPH or KPH from 50 to 284 percent off the original reading.
  • Sealed completely from water, dust, and dirt.

The new SIM-1A-M comes in a smaller size for easier mounting and allows more room for calibrating more bikes.
